items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
items.content: The venture named Coinbase and Fidelity among the issuers and asset managers in the rollout after 67 companies objected to having their shares traded on the venue.

items.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin secures $150M credit line from FalconX
items.content: The miner can borrow against its Bitcoin to fund operations and expansion after selling about 465 BTC to cover expenses in the third quarter.

items.title: Strategy buys 457 Bitcoin, spends $212M on preferred share buybacks
items.content: Strategy raised its preferred stock buyback limit to $4 billion and authorized the transfer of up to $1 billion from its dollar reserve.

items.title: AI agents are using credit cards. Where does that leave crypto?
items.content: AI agents are already using credit cards to transact, raising questions about where crypto fits in the emerging agent economy.

items.title: Critics of Netflix’s FTX drama point to Obama’s producer credit
items.content: Series creator Graham Moore said he invented a scene in which Changpeng Zhao urges Alameda Research to trade ahead of FTX customers’ orders.

items.title: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
items.content: The ECB aims to start accepting securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s distributed ledger pilot program in June 2027.

items.title: BTC price gains 12% from $55K: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
items.content: Nasdaq-100 futures rose 3.1% before Monday’s open, while Wednesday’s US inflation report could shape expectations for a December rate hike.

items.title: ‘MoldyRoost’ ads can steal crypto wallet recovery phrases from iPhones
items.content: The campaign used at least 480 ad domains to target users in more than 47 countries and could infect a vulnerable iPhone with a single tap.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.8B in third-largest weekly outflow
items.content: Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $4.14 billion in November through Friday, nearing June’s $4.51 billion total.

items.title: Trump renews call for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
items.content: In a Truth Social post on Monday, Trump said rehiring Jensen Huang would benefit both Nvidia and the US.

items.title: Billionaire Bill Ackman warns Fed will make a rate ‘mistake’ in December
items.content: Markets and economists widely expect the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in its December meeting.

items.title: Half of wallets on Trump’s dinner list got tokens from non-US exchanges
items.content: Public Citizen traced 66 of 130 qualifying wallets to exchanges that restrict US users, raising questions over who is attending Trump’s memecoin dinner on Sunday.

items.title: Will Bitcoin’s big rebound hold? More tampered Ledgers found: Hodler’s Digest
items.content: Bitcoin rebounds sharply from its new cycle low, but is $55,111 really the bottom? Ledger investigates new reports of tampered devices in Berlin and the UAE.

items.title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
items.content: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
items.content: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

items.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
items.content: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

items.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
items.content: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.

items.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
items.content: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

items.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
items.content: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

items.title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
items.content: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.

items.title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
items.content: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

items.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
items.content: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
items.content: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

items.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
items.content: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

items.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
items.content: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

items.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
items.content: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

items.title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
items.content: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

items.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
items.content: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

items.title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
items.content: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.
